about: Conformance cases for SilenceBudget and ReconnectPacer (docs/adr/0014), run by ios/Tests/RetryCaseTests.swift and android/src/test/java/com/audiobrowser/player/RetryCaseTest.kt. Times are milliseconds. Each step is one event and the deadline after it (null for none); an "ended" step also states what the connection delivered (audio or nothing), when it started, and the wait before the next connect: milliseconds, "online" or "giveUp". Any other step may state the wait too. Each case starts online, with no play intent.

cases.name: a dead address that never played gives up 12 s after its first failure
a stream that played and whose server is gone gives up after 120 s of silence, the backoff capped at 5 s
a stream that closes every 30 s reconnects at once and keeps playing
a stream that closes every 10 s reconnects at once and keeps playing past 120 s
a stream that sends 2 s of audio per connection plays choppy and gives up 120 s into its silence
a connection that stays open with no data is replaced after the watch, and silence still ends it at 120 s
a network frozen for 40 s plays again, and the silence ends
a network frozen for 150 s gives up at 120 s of silence, whatever ends in between
4.9 s of audio leaves a silence's deadline where it was, and 5 s ends the silence
the backoff grows with each connection that delivers nothing and starts over after one that delivers audio
offline during the silence of a played stream: the time counts, and the connect goes out when the network returns
offline before a load ever played: the first-connect clock restarts at the next online failure, and the silence still counts
a load that never played and stays offline gives up after 120 s
a play intent that goes down clears the deadline, and one that comes up starts a new silence
before a load ever played, a play intent that comes up again restarts the first-connect clock at the next failure, and the backoff
a new load starts over: the short budget again, and the first backoff
maxRetries 2 gives up on the third connection in a row that delivers nothing
maxRetries counts in a row: a connection that delivers audio starts the count over, one that ends offline leaves it
a connection that plays and then stalls starts the maxRetries count and the backoff over
maxRetries 0 gives up when the first connection delivers nothing
a restart after giving up is a new load: the waits and the deadline start over
a play intent that comes up while audio plays starts its silence when the audio stops
a first failure late in the silence leaves the 120 s deadline, the earlier of the two
back online, the next connect goes out at once: what remains of the backoff is dropped
a stream that closes every 5 s, audible 4.2 s of each, gives up 120 s after its load: no run reaches 5 s
maxRetries 0 on a stream that played: a drop reconnects once, and that connection delivering nothing gives up
audio after a first failure lifts a never-played load to the 120 s budget, counted from its silence
the budgets follow the limits they are given
an online event while already online leaves the backoff to run
before a load ever played, a blip offline drops the 12 s deadline until the next online failure
a connection that delivered audio and ended offline starts the count over and waits for the network
a new load while audio plays clears hasPlayed and starts a silence
a play intent that goes down offline and comes up online starts over
a play intent that comes up while already up changes nothing
